file_roles.evidence: reclaimOplog(opCtx) always called _kvEngine->getLastStableCheckpointTimestamp(); the fix adds an early branch using Timestamp::max() when !supportsRecoverToStableTimestamp(), matching the report that only RTT engines may call it.
Only adds a doc comment on reclaimOplog(opCtx, persistedTimestamp).

rationale: inMemory does not take checkpoints, yet oplog reclamation depended on the last stable checkpoint. The fix handles the non-RTT case in reclaimOplog.
